prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Your unique pet is being assembled and ready for desktop adoption.", "Confirm & Adopt"]
1: ["Select Your Ideal Desktop Pet"]
2: ["Your Desktop Comes Alive", "Discover how desktop companions hang out, play, and assist while you work.", "Choose My Path"]
3: []
4: ["Give Your Pet a Name", "Choose a name for your new desktop companion to personalize your experience.", "Continue to Adoption"]
5: ["Sign In to Protect Your Desktop Pet", "Signing in secures your companion data, pet personality, and syncs progress across all your devices seamlessly.", "Using the same account ensures your pet is never reset or lost upon launch."]
6: ["Hatching Your Pet onto Desktop...", "We are preparing your pet graphics and desktop overlay settings."]
7: ["Tip: Right-click your pet or click the System Tray mascot icon anytime to access controls, talk, or hide your companion.", "System Tray Controls Enabled"]
8: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Certified Desktop Companion"]
9: ["Don't worry: You can always adopt additional pets or customize traits after completing setup."]
